name: Xero Addons for Elementor
author: XeroDevs

sections.description:
Xero Addons is a unique plugin designed to enhance the Elementor page builder with powerful and easy-to-use elements. Specifically crafted for bloggers, marketers, business owners, and WooCommerce users, this addon allows you to build visually stunning and fully customized websites, including blogs, eCommerce stores, and personal/business websites.

💡 Xero Addons – Powerful Widgets for Elementor

Xero Addons extends Elementor with a set of lightweight, performance-focused widgets designed to enhance your website’s creativity and usability — without sacrificing speed.

😍 Elementor FREE widgets

✅ Creative Button – Stylish buttons with unique hover effects to boost call-to-action impact.

✅ Mobile Menu – Responsive off-canvas menus with flexible customization options.

✅ Creative Gallery – Elegant image gallery layouts to showcase media beautifully.

✅ Static Carousel – Non-sliding carousel for static content like testimonials or highlights.

✅ Interactive Links – Text links with immersive background hover animations.

✅ Image Stack – Visually stacked image layout with interactive hover effects.

✅ Animated Links – Text links with smooth hover animations for enhanced UX.

✅ Accordion – Collapsible content sections with smooth animations and customizable styling.

✅ Age Gate – Age verification popup with customizable design and redirect options.

✅ Brand Carousel – Rotating brand logo carousel with hover effects and linking options.

✅ Brand Grid – Static brand logo grid layout with customizable columns and spacing.

✅ Business Hour – Display business hours with custom styling and timezone support.

✅ Circle Info – Circular information boxes with icons and hover animations.

✅ Circle Menu – Circular navigation menu with smooth animations and custom icons.

✅ Comparison List – Side-by-side comparison tables with checkmarks and custom styling.

✅ Content Switcher – Toggle between different content sections with smooth transitions.

✅ Countdown – Animated countdown timer with multiple layout options and custom styling.

✅ Document Viewer – Embed and display PDF documents with viewer controls.

✅ Dropbar – Dropdown content bars with smooth animations and custom triggers.

✅ Dual Button – Two-button layout with different styles and hover effects.

✅ Featured Box – Highlight content boxes with icons, images, and call-to-action buttons.

✅ Flip Box – Interactive flip cards with front/back content and hover animations.

✅ Image Accordion – Expandable image panels with overlay content and smooth transitions.

✅ Image Compare – Before/after image comparison with draggable slider control.

✅ Image Expand – Expandable image gallery with lightbox and zoom functionality.

✅ Interactive Card – Hover-activated cards with flip, slide, and fade animations.

✅ Lightbox – Custom lightbox popup for images, videos, and content with overlay effects.

✅ Logo Carousel – Rotating logo showcase with autoplay and navigation controls.

✅ Logo Grid – Static logo grid display with hover effects and custom layouts.

✅ Modal – Custom popup modals with triggers, animations, and responsive design.

✅ Price List – Service/product pricing lists with descriptions and custom styling.

✅ Product Carousel – WooCommerce product carousel with cart buttons and product info.

✅ Product Grid – WooCommerce product grid with filtering and sorting options.

✅ Progress Pie – Circular progress indicators with percentage display and animations.

✅ Review Card Carousel – Customer review carousel with ratings and testimonials.

✅ Review Card Grid – Customer review grid layout with star ratings and avatars.

✅ Scroll Button – Smooth scroll-to-top/section buttons with custom icons and animations.

✅ Scroll Navigation – Sticky navigation that highlights current section while scrolling.

✅ Search – Custom search widget with AJAX results and advanced filtering options.

✅ Social Share – Social media sharing buttons with custom icons and hover effects.

✅ Step Flow – Process flow visualization with numbered steps and connecting lines.

✅ Total Count – Animated counter widget with icons and custom number formatting.

More widgets and features are comming soon…
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.

e.g.

  1. Upload xero-addons folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Start using it by going to the Elementor editor.
sections.faq:
Does your plugin support all WordPress themes?

  • Yes, the Xero Addons is compatible and supports all WordPress themes including popular free and premium Elementor themes.

What do I need to use the plugin?

  • Just install Xero Addons along with Elementor page builder; that’s all. Our plugin will provide you with all essential widgets to help you create your blogging site in minutes.

Do you provide tutorials on the plugin?

  • Of course, we provide detailed documentation and video to support our users with thorough guidelines for our plugins and widgets.

How do I get a solution for any issue?

  • Just contact us and we will follow up within 24 hours with our expert technical team.

How should I get updates and support

  • When we release a update version, then automatically you will get a notification on WordPress plugin manager, so you can update from there. Thereafter you want to update manually just knock us, we will send you update version via mail.
